job.job_description:
- Languages: Go (preferred), Python
- API Development: REST API design and implementation
- Database: SQL query writing and optimization
- Environment: Unix/Linux systems
 
## Experience Requirements
- Proven experience in API framework development
- Strong understanding of REST API principles and best practices
- Hands-on experience with Go or Python for backend development
- Proficient in writing complex SQL queries
- Comfortable working in Unix/Linux environments
 
## Key Competencies
- API design patterns and microservices architecture
- Database schema design and query optimization
- Version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
- Performance optimization and scalability
- API documentation and testing frameworks
 
## Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Go frameworks (Gin, Echo, Fiber)
- Knowledge of containerization (Kubernetes)
- Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP)
